name: popsicle
headline: EmailCraft: Visual Email Marketing Automation
short_description: EmailCraft is a visual email marketing automation platform that lets marketers create, schedule, and execute email campaigns using an intuitive drag-and-drop flowchart interface.
author: Thanisha23

sections.overview:
EmailCraft is a web-based email marketing automation platform built with Next.js and React that enables users to design and manage email sequences through a visual flowchart editor. The platform supports user authentication, lead management via email list imports, and email scheduling at specific intervals using Agenda.js for job scheduling. Users can execute campaigns directly from the flowchart interface, with Nodemailer handling email delivery. The backend uses Express and MongoDB for data persistence, while JWT authentication secures user accounts. EmailCraft simplifies email campaign creation for marketers who need visual workflow tools without requiring technical coding expertise.
Create automated email sequences for customer onboarding flows
Schedule and execute multi-step email campaigns to imported contact lists
Manage email marketing workflows using visual flowchart-based design
Build lead nurturing campaigns with drag-and-drop email nodes
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Thanisha23/EmailCraft`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an email marketing expert for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Create a 3-email drip campaign to promote [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Include subject lines, preheaders, and body content. Focus on [TARGET AUDIENCE] and highlight [KEY BENEFIT]. Use a friendly yet professional tone.
```
